punchline: Airbnb started with "why can't we host these visitors," not "how do we make rent."
thirty_sec: In 2007 two San Francisco roommates short on rent saw conference visitors who couldn't find a hotel. They asked why they couldn't host them, then rented three air mattresses to strangers. Next they asked what it would take to offer more than a mattress and built their own website. Warren Berger uses the sequence to show why, what if, how in that order.
